answer: Duplicating identities requires buying and physically hosting a new beacon per sybil, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest agents pay only once, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a saffron-tagged bond locked to a unique hardware beacon, and the network samples random shale-anchored checkpoints where agents prove liveness by signing with that beacon. This model fits agent Agent0149's threat model.
